CommunicationMethod.name: Communication Method
CommunicationMethod.definition: Method by which the document is to be delivered.

Medium.name: Medium
Medium.definition: Medium through which the presentation can be submitted such as paper, electronic or both.

PresentationDate.name: Presentation Date
PresentationDate.definition: Date on which the presentation is made.

ApplicableChannel.name: Applicable Channel
ApplicableChannel.definition: Channel used for the transmission of a document.

PresentedUndertaking.name: Presented Undertaking
PresentedUndertaking.definition: Specifies the undertaking which is presented and its associated documents.

ElectronicPresentationAddress.name: Electronic Presentation Address
ElectronicPresentationAddress.definition: Electronic address for the presentation of documents.
